decisionsTitle: Race results public from the start, live while the race runs, and why a line is «Participant #…»
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-18, from the phone**, with a screenshot of «Clasament» — every line «Pe site: Participant #001», the chip «Nepublic», the alert «Cursa nu a început încă»: «pe site live trebuie sa vad lista de finish, atat ca admin cat si public, trebe sa setez ca toata lumea apare pe site, toate BIB-urile insa doar numele celor care au bifat ca vor sa apara se vad» — and «ce inseamna "Loc" aici?». Asked, he chose: (1) **public from the start** — the tick may be set now; before the start the site shows nothing, from the start every finish appears on the event page; (2) **the reason** — under every «Pe site: Participant #…» a short sentence why there is no name, and at the top «Cu nume pe site: N din M»; (3) **live** — while the race runs, the public list refreshes itself every 30 seconds while the page is open, and after the race it does nothing.

**What was there.** §808 published a race's results on the Administrator's tick alone and refused the tick before the race (`RESULTS_NOT_STARTED`), because the privacy notice's template says «Clasamentul unei curse … apare doar după cursă». The public side already waited for the event's start: the read (`readPublicEventResults`), its cached twin (`cachedPublicEventResults`), the section (§809), the listing's chip and the page's hold (`results-open.ts#resultsOnShow`, `resultsClockInstants`) showed nothing before `startsAt` and every stored row from it. Who is named is `publicResultName` (§808, §810, §879, §910). The «Pe site:» line said «Participant #bib» without saying why, and «Loc» was a column's word with nothing to explain it on a phone, where the column has no header.

**Decision 1 — the tick before the race.** `setResultsPublished(on)` no longer refuses before the start; the code `RESULTS_NOT_STARTED` is gone, since nothing throws it. FORBIDDEN, RESULTS_NOT_OPEN, RESULTS_NOTICE and RESULTS_TERMS are kept before the start as after it, taking the results off is never refused, the audit row is the same `event_results.published`, and `results_published_at` is the tick's moment. The answer says `fromStart` and the toast says the results appear on the page from the start. **Nothing that is shown changes**: before `startsAt` the read and the cached read answer nothing, the section draws nothing, the listing gives no chip and the page and the listing are held until the start, so a copy made before it is made again then — each proved with a «Neprezentat» typed two days early (`tests/integration/results/public-from-start.test.ts`). From the start every stored row shows as it is saved, and the public line «Publicat …» names the start, not the earlier tick (`domain/from-start.ts#resultsShownSince`). «Clasament» says the state from one pure rule (`resultsPublishState`): «Nepublic»; **«Public de la start»** while ticked before the race — a chip in the summary row, the card's header, and in the card the chip with «Pe site apare de la start, sâm., 21 nov. 2026, la 09:00, pe măsură ce sosesc alergătorii.»; «Public» from the start. Unticked before the race, the card says the tick may be set now — to whoever may set it (`canPublishResults`): the Organizer's card says «Doar un administrator poate publica clasamentul.» and nothing more. «Cursa nu a început încă» now says results may be typed and, to an Administrator, the tick set, and that nothing shows before the start; the Organizer is told only that results may be typed. While the start's date or hour is still to be announced (§533) the card names no hour — the public side has no start then, so nothing shows until it is announced — and says the results appear from the start once its hour is announced. The question asked before ticking says the results show from the start. The guide's task «Publică clasamentul pe pagina evenimentului», SETUP.md §45 and the runbook say the same.

**The notice's sentence.** The privacy notice's template says «Clasamentul unei curse … apare doar după cursă», and the terms' template «îl publicăm doar după cursă». §808 already showed the results from the event's start; this keeps exactly that timing — the tick may be **set** earlier, nothing is **shown** earlier — so nothing on the page contradicts an approved text more than before. The live refresh makes it plainer that results appear while the race runs, so the club and its lawyer may want both sentences to say «de la startul cursei, pe măsură ce sosesc alergătorii». No legal template is edited: the texts are the club's (§29).

**Decision 2 — why «Participant #…».** `results/domain/public-name-reason.ts#publicNameReason`, pure, over `publicResultName`'s own input and one fact more — `hiddenByClub`: the person ticked, and an Administrator's «Apare pe site» unticked on an elite or an ambassador (§910, §948) is what reads the tick as off. That boolean is worked out in `results.ts#siteHiddenByClub`, beside `tickedForTheSite`, from the same columns, and handed to the reason: the «Ambasador» mark stays read only by the reviewed files of `tests/unit/registrations/ambassador-never-leaves.test.ts`, and `public-name-reason.ts` names no mark. It asks `publicResultName` first — `named` exactly when it gives a name — then names the first condition that failed: `noResultsNotice` (no approved notice describes the results: nobody is named; first, because every line shares it), for a runner typed by hand `noName` then `typedNoAgreement`, for a registered one `notTicked`, `hiddenByClub`, `notConfirmed`, `hiddenGuest`, `olderNotice`, `noName`. A table-driven test walks all 147 456 combinations of the input and holds the two together, and that the club's tick never moves a name. `readEventResults` hands every line `named` — still `publicResultName`'s own answer — and `nameReason` from one input (`publicNameVerdict`). «Clasament» draws the reason's sentence under each «Pe site: Participant #…» — never under a named line, an elite out of the ranking, or an erased registration's nameless line, whose own sentence says why — «Cu nume pe site: N din M» in the summary row (M, the lines the published results would show: a stored result, not an elite out of the ranking; N, those named), and, while no approved notice describes the results, that reason once at the top with a link to «Documente legale» instead of on every line. **Who is named does not change**: the function names nobody, `publicResultName` is untouched, and the public read is untouched.

**Decision 3 — live.** `results/domain/live-window.ts`: a race runs from the event's start until its end, or six hours after the start for a race saved without one (or with an end at or before its start). Inside that window, on a race whose results are ticked, `ResultsSection` draws `ResultsLiveRefresh` — a client island with plain props (the window's end in milliseconds and the line's words; no icon, nothing from `action-icons.ts`, no new dependency) — which calls `router.refresh()` every 30 seconds while `document.visibilityState` is `visible`, at once on becoming visible again when a refresh is due, and nothing from the window's end, when its one calm line «Se actualizează singur la 30 de secunde» goes too. Its clock is `ui/live-refresh.ts`, unit-tested with fake timers. **Whether it is drawn is read from the event's row alone** — the tick as saved (`resultsTicked`, on `PUBLIC_COLUMNS` beside `resultsPublished`, which is «ticked and a result stored» and stays what the section, the chip and the hold read), a race, the window (`resultsLiveRefreshUntil`) — never from a read that can fail. So it is drawn in the section, under «Publicat …», with its line; and, while the section is not drawn, alone and silent in its place (`results-live-quiet`, no line, nothing to see): the sheet still empty before the first finish — the results ticked on Thursday, the race at 09:00 on Saturday, a page opened at 09:10 shows the finish saved at 09:25 at its next refresh, and every later one — or the database away at that render, when the section is left out as the start list is (§447) and the next refresh that reaches the database draws it again. Nothing is drawn while the texts in force no longer describe the results: no saved result could show. The page is held to the window's start and end (`resultsLiveInstants`), so a copy made before the race is made again at the start with the island, and one made during it again at the end without. `ResultsFilter` narrows the rows a refresh redraws by the chip and the number already chosen. **What it costs.** One request per open, visible tab every 30 seconds while the race runs; nothing from a hidden tab or outside the window. For an anonymous visitor at the page's bare address — the public — the CDN answers it from the static page while nothing changed; a save expires the `events` and `places` tags (§333, §549), so the next request after it renders the page again, and that render refills every `events`- and `places`-tagged read the page makes, not the results' alone. **A signed-in tab** — staff, the owner watching «ca admin», a member — **or an address with a query the page reads** (`?lista=`, `?interest=`, `?since=`, `?declaratie=`) is the page's live twin (`src/proxy.ts`, `i18n/live-twin.ts`): there every refresh is a full server render with the session read, per request — one function render every 30 seconds per such visible tab for the whole window, up to six hours for a race saved without an end, the kind of per-request render §577 (B1) declines a signed-in reader's prefetches to avoid. At §549's measured ~68 ms of CPU a render, a signed-in tab kept visible through a six-hour window is about 50 seconds of Active CPU. Proved end to end on a production build with Playwright's `page.clock` (`tests/e2e/race-results-live.spec.ts`): a result saved while the visitor's page is open appears only when the page's clock reaches thirty seconds, with no reload — on a page already showing results, where a number typed in the filter hides the row the refresh adds, and on a page opened before the first finish; past the window the page asks nothing more. **Amends §577** («no polling in an open tab»): this is its one named exception, bounded to the race's window and to a visible tab — a CDN request for the public, a server render each time for the live twin; `tests/unit/config/idle-client.test.ts` names it and refuses any other island that refreshes a page from a timer.

**«Loc».** Once, above both panels of lines — «Alergători înscriși» and the runners typed by hand, whose lines say «Loc:» too — one sentence says it in plain words — the place in the ranking, overall and, under it, by sex and by category, worked out by the site from the times, and «fără loc încă» until a time is typed — with the ties, the category and «fără loc» behind its «?». Said above the lines rather than in the column's header, because a phone has none; nothing while there is no line at all.

**Refused.** Publishing names on a tick given under an older notice — the older terms promised to ask first (§808, §879); the line now says so instead (`olderNotice`). A staff tick that names anybody: the club's «Apare pe site» stays a hide (§910). Showing anything before the start, or a heading «în curând». A websocket, server-sent events or a polling API: the page's own refresh through the cache is cheaper and adds no route. Refreshing a hidden tab, or after the race. Editing a legal template. A migration.

**Not done.** A longer period for the live twin: the island could be told which render it is drawn in and ask a signed-in tab less often, but the owner asked to watch the finish list live «atat ca admin cat si public», and the cost above is bounded by the window and by a visible tab. Keeping the last ranking on an open tab through a refresh that finds the database away: that render leaves «Clasament» out (the page is kept a minute, §447) and the island alone keeps asking, so the next refresh that reaches the database draws it again — before this change an open tab never lost its results only because it never refreshed. «Toate datele unei persoane» lists the stored flag `results_published` as it is, true from the tick though nothing shows before the start. A typed row whose number a confirmed registration took since keeps its §810 behaviour: «Clasament» reads that line as the registered runner's (and counts it so in «Cu nume pe site») while the public line is «Participant #bib» until the next «Salvează tot clasamentul» re-files it.
changelogLine: - **Race results public from the start, and live** — an Administrator can tick «Clasamentul e public pe pagina evenimentului» before the race («Public de la start», with the start's day and hour): nothing shows until the start, then every saved finish appears on the event page, which refreshes itself every 30 seconds while the race runs; «Clasament» says under each «Pe site: Participant #…» why there is no name, counts «Cu nume pe site: N din M», and explains «Loc» in plain words. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: 75. (amended) Given the privacy notice and the terms in force, when an Administrator ticks «Clasamentul e public pe pagina evenimentului», then the tick is refused with a sentence and a link to «Documente legale» unless the notice and the terms in force name `{{results}}` in both languages (the platform's templates do, replacing «Rezultate cu nume nu publicăm încă»); before the race has started it is accepted — the answer says the results show from the start and «Clasament» says «Public de la start» — with every other refusal (FORBIDDEN, RESULTS_NOT_OPEN, RESULTS_NOTICE, RESULTS_TERMS) kept and the same audit row; taking the results off is never refused; `/admin/tasks` carries the rows `resultsNotice` and `resultsTerms` until such texts are in force. Verification: integration `results/results.test.ts`, `results/actions.test.ts`, `results/public-from-start.test.ts`, unit `results/notice.test.ts`, `diagnostics/owner-tasks.test.ts` (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §808) (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a race whose results an Administrator ticked public before it started, with a result already stored (a «Neprezentat» typed early), when the public read, its cached twin, the event page's «Clasament» and the listing are asked before the event's start, then each answers nothing — no row, no section, no heading, no chip — and the page and the listing are held until the start; from the start every stored row is shown, and the line «Publicat …» names the start, not the earlier tick. Verification: integration `results/public-from-start.test.ts`, `results/results.test.ts`; unit `results/live-refresh.test.ts` (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a race whose results an Administrator ticked public, when its page is drawn between the event's start and its end — or six hours after the start for a race saved without an end — then «Clasament» carries one line «Se actualizează singur la 30 de secunde» and the page refreshes itself every 30 seconds while the tab is visible (at once on coming back visible when a refresh is due), a result saved since appearing without a reload; while no result is stored yet, or the database is away at that render, the refresh is drawn alone, with no line and nothing visible, so the first result saved — or the section, once the database answers — appears at the next refresh; nothing is drawn while the texts in force do not describe the results; a row a refresh adds is narrowed by the category and the number the visitor already chose; outside that window there is no line and nothing is asked, and no other public island refreshes a page from a timer. Verification: unit `results/live-refresh.test.ts`, `config/idle-client.test.ts`; integration `results/public-from-start.test.ts`; e2e `race-results-live.spec.ts` (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given any input of the published results' name rule, when the reason a result carries no name is asked, then it is «named» exactly when `publicResultName` gives a name, and otherwise the first condition that failed — no approved notice describing the results, a typed runner's missing name or recorded agreement, the runner's own tick off, the club's «Apare pe site» off on a runner who ticked, a registration not confirmed, a special guest the event hides, an older notice not asked since, a blank name — and the club's tick names nobody. Verification: unit `results/public-name-reason.test.ts` (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a race's «Clasament» page, when it is drawn, then under each «Pe site: Participant #…» line one sentence says why the site shows no name, in Romanian and in English, and none under a named line or an elite out of the ranking; the summary row says «Cu nume pe site: N din M» (M the lines with a result the published results would show, N those named); while no approved notice describes the results that reason is said once at the top instead of on every line; once above both panels of lines — the registered and the typed by hand — one sentence says what «Loc» is — the place overall and, under it, by sex and by category, worked out from the times, «fără loc încă» until a time is typed — with the rest behind its «?», and none while there is no line; ticked before the race, the summary, the card's header and the card say «Public de la start», the card with the start's day and hour — or, while the start's date or hour is to be announced, that the results appear once its hour is announced; and before the race an Administrator is told the tick may be set now, the Organizer only that results may be typed. Verification: integration `results/page-public-names.test.ts`, `results/page.test.ts`; e2e `race-results-live.spec.ts` (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: race results public from the start, live every 30 seconds, and why «Participant #…»
